chapter_name: Fundamental Skills of Sports - Team Games
learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the magic of working together! Discover how passing, catching, and supporting your friends makes team sports super fun.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In team games like basketball, football, or kabaddi, nobody wins alone! Working together, communicating, and cheering for your friends is the best way to play.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🏐 The Art of Passing and Catching
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Passing is sharing the ball with your teammate, and catching requires keeping your eyes on the ball at all times. These are the most important skills to master!
Team sports are also brain games! You have to think fast, find open spaces on the field, and plan how to score a goal together.

fun_activity.title: 🎈 The Keep-It-Up Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Grab a balloon and a sibling or parent. Try to keep the balloon in the air by passing it back and forth for 2 minutes without letting it touch the ground!

quick_recap: ⭐ Team games teach us how to communicate, share, and support each other.
⭐ Passing and catching smoothly requires good eye-hand coordination.
⭐ Playing fair and respecting everyone is the true sign of a great team player.
